what: Turns the FM-1 into a C64 SID machine: two SIDs measured on real chips, a GoatTracker 2 tracker with swing, Euclid and ratchets, .sid playback and .sid to song, LAB with tables and LFOs, four MIDI parts for a DAW, AI-made songs and sounds, SidStation banks, Bluetooth MIDI and keyboards, Live Link.
